page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet, no printed text block. At the top right, the e-rara logo. Centred below it, the digitiser's title block (website, catalogue title, author, place and year, library, shelf mark, persistent link). Below a rule, a multilingual notice on the digitisation platform (German, English, French, Italian). Below a second rule, the terms-of-use notice in four languages. At the bottom right, the Visual Library logo.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page. The logo, title block, shelf mark, persistent link, usage notice and Visual Library logo were added by the digitiser and are left out. Nothing on this scan is printed text of the book.
